name: _sd_key
docstring: A property name as the questions use it: 'Color_Options:' -> 'color', 'bedding size 2' -> 'bedding size'.

name: _sd_json_all
docstring: Every top-level JSON object in a model's reply, in order.

name: _sd_json_in
docstring:
The first JSON object holding the key `need` (any object when None), also inside a wrapper's string values
(a reply the transport wrapped as {"content": "..."}).

name: _sd_facts
docstring: A listing's properties as {key: value text}, whatever shape the world gives them.

name: _sd_cat_fit
docstring:
How well a store category names a product: shared word stems over all of them, 0 unless the product's head
noun (its last word) is among them.

name: _sd_distinct
docstring: Up to n properties, none a word-subset of another already taken ('resolution' / 'display resolution').

name: SendoAsk.think
docstring: The first model in `models` whose reply holds a JSON object with the key `need`; None when none did.

name: SendoAsk.merge_twins
docstring: 'pack type', 'packtype' and 'pack types' are one property (named as most listings name it).

name: SendoAsk.again_list
docstring:
The same product again. The reply to a list is about its first tracked property, so: after a told
property, what came after it; after 'lost' (most often nothing tracked was named), new properties first;
after 'don't mind' (a decoy came first), the rest of the list backwards, which puts what stood behind the
decoy ahead of it.

name: BodyAsk.send_one
docstring: One message of the plan: sent, its products' state kept, the reply read. False when it was not sent.

name: Cairn.ledger
calls: f"pick: the {pick} {brief.get('pick_measure') or ''} among fitting listings".replace

name: Cairn.unread_pages
calls: ' '.join((v for v in args.values() if isinstance(v, str))).lower
